تستمعوا (form VIII)
# تَسْتَمِعُوا (tastamiʕū) /tas.ta.mi.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
# تُسْتَمَعُوا (tustamaʕū) /tus.ta.ma.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
